ARRL 国家流量系统（NTS）的标准无线电报格式：固定报头（preamble）: ARRL National Traffic System (NTS) standard radiogram: a fixed preamble, addressee address, text and signature, with the text set off by a BT (spoken as BREAK) before and after; the "check" (word count) field lets receiving stations verify that nothing was dropped.
第一行：编号、优先级、处理指令（可选）、台站、检查、地点、时间（可选）、日期。除: First line: number, precedence, handling instructions (optional), station of origin, check, place of origin, time (optional), date. All fields except check must not change in transit.
正文的词 / 组数：纯字母词、纯数字组、混合字母数字组、单独出现的标点各算 1。: The word/group count of the text: a pure-letter word, a pure-digit group, a mixed alphanumeric group, and a standalone punctuation mark each count as 1. Receiving stations recount to detect errors.
紧急 EMERGENCY / 优先 P / 福利 W / 常规 R 四档，决定报: Four levels — Emergency / Priority P / Welfare W / Routine R — that set delivery priority in the network; Emergency is always spelled out in full in the preamble, never abbreviated.
可选的投递方式指令（HXA–HXG），如电话投递、限时取消、回报收到时间等。: Optional delivery instructions (HXA–HXG), such as telephone delivery, time-limited cancellation, or reporting receipt time.
FEMA 事件指挥系统（ICS）的通用消息表：九宫格式的字段表，供现场各指挥单元: The FEMA Incident Command System general message form: a field table for passing written messages between on-scene units; it is a separate format from the NTS Radiogram.
由发信站分配，用于追踪: Assigned by the originating station for tracking
EMERGENCY / P / W / R 四档: Four levels EMERGENCY / P / W / R
涉及生命财产即时危险，其他流量一律让路。报头里写全称 EMERGENCY，不写: Immediate danger to life or property; all other traffic yields. Write the full word EMERGENCY in the preamble, not E.
重要但有时间限制，先于福利与常规。: Important but time-limited; ahead of welfare and routine.
灾难期间关于个人健康 / 安全的查询或报告。: An inquiry or report about the health or safety of individuals during a disaster.
授权在指定英里数内用电话投递。: Authorizes telephone delivery within a specified number of miles.
指定小时数内未送达则取消。: Cancel if not delivered within a specified number of hours.
回报收到日期与时间。: Report date and time of receipt.
回报经手转发站的身份。: Report the identity of the relaying station.
送达站向收件人索取回复并回传。: Delivering station obtains a reply from the addressee and returns it.
保留到指定日期再投递。: Hold delivery until a specified date.
本次事件 / 演练的名称（可选）。: Name of the incident or exercise (optional).
收件人姓名与职位。: Name and position of the recipient.
发件人姓名与职位。: Name and position of the sender.
填发日期与时间。: Date and time the message is filed.
正文，简明扼要。: The text; concise and to the point.
批准该消息的人员与职位。: Name and position of the person approving the message.
「检查」是 NTS 报文的核心：正文写好后点数填进报头，收报站抄完再点一遍，不同: The check is the heart of the NTS radiogram: count the words after writing the text, put it in the preamble, and the receiving station recounts to detect any drop.
正文每个「组」（词 / 数字 / 混合 / 拼出的标点词）算 1；句号写成字母: Each group in the text (word / digits / mixed / spelled-out punctuation word) counts as 1; a period is written as the letter X, which is itself one group and never the last group of the text; the BT (BREAK on voice) before and after the text is not counted.
优先级按实际紧急程度填，不要滥用「紧急」——应急网络靠这四档分配资源。: Use the precedence that matches the actual urgency — do not overuse "emergency"; the emergency network relies on these four levels to allocate resources.
ICS-213 面向现场指挥单元之间的书面往来，NTS Radiogram 面向: ICS-213 is for written exchanges between on-scene units, while NTS Radiogram is for long-distance passing through the amateur network; they are not interchangeable.
